chapter.verse: A lian mahmah Theofilas aw, a cil panin mittang in a muh teci leh Pasian thuhilh na a sem mite in hong gen uh mah bangin,
eite lakah a hong piangsa thu teng, eite hong zaksak a kizomin lai a gelh mi tampi a om hi.
Keimah in zong tua thu khempeuh a cil panin tel takin ka dot ciangin
nangmah hong kihilhsa thute aman takpi hi, cih na theih nadingin a kizomin gelhin zasak ning, ci-in ka ngaihsun hi.
Judah gam Herod kumpipa a man’ lai-in Abijah pawlte lakah Zekhariah a min nei siampi khat a om hi. Tuapa’ zi in Aaron suan hi a, a min Elisabeth ahi hi.
Tua tegel in Pasian’ thukham khempeuh leh Pasian’ ngeina khempeuh zui uh a, mawhsak na’ng om loin Pasian mai-ah mipha ahi uh hi.
Elisabeth in tasel ahih ciangin, a khan’ teek dongin ta a nei kei uh hi.
Zekhariah in ama pawlte tawh a ban ban Pasian mai-ah siampi na a sep hun tung a; siampite za ngeina bangin biakna innpi sungah lutin, paknamtui mei tawh hal nading thu a ngah hi.
Paknamtui mei tawh a hal hun lai takin mi khempeuh in inn pua lamah thu ngenin a om uh hi.
Tua lai takin Topa’ vangtungmi khat hong kilang a; paknamtui tau taklam ah a ding hi.
Zekhariah in vantungmi a muh ciangin lunghimawhin a lau hi.
Vantungmi in, “Zekhariah aw, lau kei in. Na thungetna hong ngai zo hi. Na zi Elisabeth in tapa khat nang ading a nei ding hi. Tua tapa’ min Johan na phuak ding hi.
Nangmah in zong lungdamna leh nuamna na ngah ding a, ama suahna hangin mi tampite zong a lungdam ding uh hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih leh, tua tapa in Topa mai-ah milian ahi ding hi. Amah in leenggahtui leh zu neukha beek dawn loin, a nu gil sung pan akipan Kha Siangtho tawh a kidim ding hi.
Israel mipawl tampi amau Topa Pasian kiangah a kiheisak kik ding hi.

A pate’ lungsim un tate kiangah kiheisak nading ahi zongin, thu ngai lo mite in midikte’ pilna lampi ah kiheisak nading ahi zongin, Topa ading a kibawlkhol mite a pian’ nading ahi zongin amah in Elijah’ lungsim leh vangliatna tawh Pasian mai-ah a pai ding hi,” ci-in a gen hi.
Zekhariah in, “Tua banga na piang ding bangci-in ke’n ka thei ding hiam? Kei puteek ka hi hi; ka zi zong a khan’ sawt zo hi,” ci-in a gen ciangin,
vantungmi in, “Keimah in Pasian kiangah a ding Gabriel ka hi hi. Nangmah hopih a, hih lungdamna thu hong zasak dingin hong sawl hi.
Nangmah in a hun a cin’ cianga a tung ding ka thu um lo na hih ciangin, hih thu a pian’ ni dongin pau thei loin na om ding hi,” a ci hi.
Mite in Zekhariah ngak uh a, biakna inn sungah sawtpi a om ciangin lamdang a sa uh hi.
Amah hong paikhiat ciangin, amaute kiangah pau thei lo ahih ciangin, biakna innpi sungah maang mu hi, ci-in a thei khin uh hi. Zekhariah in lim bek lak a, pau loin a om hi.
Siampi nasepna a bei ciangin Zekhariah innah a ciah hi.
Tua nung ciangin, ama zi Elisabeth a gai hi.
“Midangte kiangah ka thuak gensiatna, Topa in hong paihkhiatsak nadingin kei hong en-in, hih bangin keima tungah hong bawl zo hi,” ci-in kha nga tawntung inn sungah a bucip hi.
Kha nga khit ciangin, Galile gam Nazareth kici khua khatah,
David’ suan Josef min neipa tawh a kingai nungak kiangah, Pasian in a vangtungmi Gabriel a sawl hi. Tua nungak’ min in Mari ahi hi.
Gabriel in ama kiang a tun’ ciangin, “Thupha a ngah nungak aw, na cidam ta hen. Topa in nang tawh a omkhawm hi,” a ci hi.
Mari in tua thugenna hangin lungmang a, “Hih hopihna in bangci bang hopihna ahi ding hiam?” ci-in a ngaihsun hi.
Vantungmi in, “Mari aw, lau kei in. Nang in Pasian maipha na ngah zo hi.
Gai-in tapa na nei ding hi. Tua tapa’ min Zeisu na phuak ding hi.
Tua ta in milian hi ding a, Sang Bel Pasian’ Tapa kici ding hi. A pa David’ tokhom Pasian in pia ding a,
amah in Jakob’ suante a tawntungin uk ding a, ama gam in a bei ngei kei ding hi,” a ci hi.
Mari in, “Hih thu in bangci piang ding ahi hiam? Pasal ka nei kei hi,” a ci hi.
Vantungmi in zong, “Kha Siangtho in nangma tungah hong tung a, Sang Bel Pasian’ vangliatna in nang hong liah ding hi. Tua ahih ciangin, tua siangtho a piang ta in Pasian’ Tapa a kici ding hi.
Tua longal, tasel kici na beh Elisabeth in zong a teek zawh hangin tapa gai a, tu-in kha guk a pha zo hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih leh, Pasian in sep theih loh a nei kei hi,” a ci hi.
Mari in, “Pasian’ sila numei ka hi hi, nangma thu bangin kei tungah hong piang ta hen,” a cih khit ciangin, vantungmi in ama kiang panin a paikhia hi.
Tua lai takin Mari ding a, khamtungah Judah khuapi khatah manlangin pai a,
Zekhariah’ innah lutin Elisabeth va hopih hi.
Mari hopihna thu Elisabeth in a zak ciangin, a gil sunga om naungeek diang a, amah in Kha Siangtho tawh kidim hi.
“Nangmah in numei lakah thupha ngah na hi hi. Na gil sunga om naungeek in thupha a ngah ding hi.
Ka Topa’ nu kei kiangah hong pai nadingin bang hangin hehpihna ke’n ka ngah hiam?
Nong hopihna aw ke’n ka zak ciangin ka gil sunga om naungeek in lungdamna tawh a diang hi.
Thu-um numei in thupha a ngah ding hi. Bang hang hiam na cih leh, tua numei kiangah Topa’ thugente hong tangtung ding hi,” ci-in aw lian tawh a gen hi.
Mari in zong, “Keima lungsim in Topa a pahtawi hi.
Keimah hong gum Topa Pasian hangin ka kha a nuam hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih leh, ama sila numei’ kiniamsakna hong en zo hi. Tu-a kipanin khang khempeuhte in kei thupha a ngah mi hong ci ding hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih leh, vangliatna a neipa in keima tungah a lian thute hong hih zo hi. Tua pa min’ a siangtho hi.
Amah kihta mite tungah, Khang khat pan khang khat dongin ama hehpihna a om tawntung ding hi.
Ama ban tawh vangliatna a lak zo hi. Amau ngaihsutna lungsim uh a kiphasakte kikhenthang sak zo hi.
Amah in kumpite a kumpi tokhom tung pan kiasak a, mizawngte khangtosak zo hi.
A gilkial mite an pha tawh vak a, Sum haute khut guak tawh a paikhiasak zo hi.
I pu i pate kiangah a gen ngei mah bangin, Abraham akipan ama suan leh khakte tungah,
Hehpihna thupha a tawntungin a ngaihsut theih nadingin, Ama sila Israel kiangah huhna a pia zo hi,” a ci hi.
Mari in Elisabeth kiangah kha thum a om khit ciangin, innah a ciahkik hi.
Elizabeth suah hun a cin’ khit ciangin, tapa a suak hi.
Topa in a lian hehpihna Elisabeth tungah a bawl, a inn vengte leh a behte in a zak uh ciangin, amah tawh kibangin lungdamin a nuam uh hi.
Ni giat ni khit ciangin, naungeek’ vun at dingin amaute hong pai uh a, a pa min zui-in Zekhariah a phuak nuam uh hi.
Ahih hangin a nu in, “Hi lo hi, a min Johan kiphuak ding hi,” a cih ciangin,
amaute in, “Hih min in na behte lakah khat beek kiphuak lo hi,” a ci uh hi.
A pa kiangah, “Bang phuak nuam na hi hiam?” ci-in lim tawh a dong uh hi.
Zekhariah in lai ngen a, “Ama min in Johan ahi ding hi,” ci-in a gelh ciangin amaute khempeuh in lamdang a sa uh hi.
Tua leh, thakhatin Zekhariah kam kihong a, a leii kikhah a, Pasian phatin a pau thei hi.
A inn vengte khempeuh lau uh a, tua thu khempeuh Judah gam khamtung khempeuh ah kizeel hi.
A za khempeuhte in a lungsim sung uh ah ciamteh uh a, “Hih naungeek in bangci bang mi hi ding ahi hiam?” a ci uh hi. Bang hang hiam i cih leh, Topa’ khut in amah tawh a omkhawm hi.
Tua naungeek’pa Zekhariah in Kha Siangtho tawh kidim a, kamsan’na tawh a gen-inah:
“Israel mipawl’ Topa Pasian in thupha ngah ta hen.
Bang hang hiam i cih leh, tanglai ama kamsang siangthote’ kam tawh a gen kholh mah bangin,
Eite in i galte’ khut sung pan i kikhahkhiat khit ciangin, Ama mai-ah i khan’ tawntung sian’thona leh thumanna in,
Lau loin ama’ na i sep theih nading ahi zongin, i pa Abraham tungah thuciamna leh
A siangtho ama kamciamsa thu a ngaihsut nading ahi zongin, i pu i pate tungah hehpihna thupha hong bawl nading ahi zongin,
Ama mi pawlte hong veh in, a hong tankhia zo hi, Eite in i galte khut sung pan ahi zongin,
A hong mudah khempeuhte khut sung pan ahi zongin, hong gupkhiat nadingin,
Ama sila David’ suan lak panin, Eite adingin kii khat ahi alian hong Gumpa a piangsak zo hi.
Ahi hi, naungeek aw, nangmah in Sang Bel Topa’ kamsangpa hong kici ding hi. Bang hang hiam na cih leh, eite Pasian hong hehpihna thupha hangin ah Ama mi pawlte’ khialhna maisakna tawh,
Gupna thu ama mipawlte na theihsak nading ahi zongin, ama lampi na sial nading ahi zongin, Nang in Topa mai-ah na pai ding hi. Tua hehpihna hangin
Khuamial leh sihna lim sungah a tu mite tungah, khuavak hong tan’ nading ahi zongin, Nopna lampi ah eite hong kha ding ahi zongin,
A tung panin ni suakin eite kiangah hong tang ding hi,” ci-in a gen hi.
Tua naungeek khang a, a lungsim siamna khangto a, Israel mite kiangah a kilah ni matengin gampa lakah a om hi.
